text: You see an aged woman.
source_text: You see an aged woman.

text: You see Agatha.
source_text: You see Agatha.

text: This woman is wrinkled and gray, yet has a spry step and a bright personality.
source_text:
This woman is wrinkled and gray, yet has a spry step and a bright
 personality.

text: You are a bad person. I will have nothing to do with you.
source_text: You are a bad person. I will have nothing to do with you.

text: It is a terrible thing when our youth are threatened. The loss of Tandi would be a terrible thing.
source_text:
It is a terrible thing when our youth are threatened. The loss
 of Tandi would be a terrible thing.

text: Hnng.
source_text: Hnng.

text: Okay.
source_text: Okay.

text: Why?
source_text: Why?

text: What do you mean?
source_text: What do you mean?

text: I know you will do your best, dearie. Find Tandi, help her escape those beasts and return her to Aradesh. You will do this community a favor and build good karma as well.
source_text:
I know you will do your best, dearie. Find Tandi, help her escape those
 beasts and return her to Aradesh. You will do this community a favor and
 build good karma as well.

text: Aradesh loves his daughter very much. It is that love that makes him the man that he is and a pillar of this community. Without that love he would be lost, and Shady Sands would surely follow . . .
source_text:
Aradesh loves his daughter very much. It is that love that makes him the
 man that he is and a pillar of this community. Without that love he
 would be lost, and Shady Sands would surely follow . . .

text: I will do my best. Goodbye.
source_text: I will do my best. Goodbye.

text: I could use some help.
source_text: I could use some help.

text: Hmmm. We'll see.
source_text: Hmmm. We'll see.

text: I feel that she is imprisoned. She was the target of hatred. That hate is very strong to the southeast. I'm sure you will find her there. Good luck.
source_text:
I feel that she is imprisoned. She was the target of hatred. That hate is
 very strong to the southeast. I'm sure you will find her there. Good luck.

text: Thank you.
source_text: Thank you.

text: You have not heard? Tandi is missing. I feel she was kidnapped. Aradesh is most distraught. This is a terrible thing . . .
source_text:
You have not heard? Tandi is missing. I feel she was kidnapped.
 Aradesh is most distraught. This is a terrible thing . . .

text: I hear that you have saved Tandi. That was the right thing to do. Your karma is strong. I have high hopes for your future.
source_text:
I hear that you have saved Tandi. That was the right thing to do.
 Your karma is strong. I have high hopes for your future.

text: I'm very sorry to hear about Tandi. She was such a bright young woman. She would have done good with her life.
source_text:
I'm very sorry to hear about Tandi. She was such a bright young woman.
 She would have done good with her life.

text: Hello. You must be the stranger everyone is talking about. [Agatha sighs.] How can I help you?
source_text:
Hello. You must be the stranger everyone is talking about.
 [Agatha sighs.] How can I help you?

text: Hngh.
source_text: Hngh.

text: Who are you?
source_text: Who are you?

text: You look very tired. Is there anything wrong?
source_text: You look very tired. Is there anything wrong?

text: Why do you look so tired?
source_text: Why do you look so tired?

text: Don't talk to me, old woman.
source_text: Don't talk to me, old woman.

text: You need more help than I can give you, child. May Dharma be with you.
source_text: You need more help than I can give you, child. May Dharma be with you.

text: My name is Agatha. I am the storyteller of Shady Sands. It is my job to keep the history so that we may remember and never forget.
source_text:
My name is Agatha. I am the storyteller of Shady Sands. It is my job
 to keep the history so that we may remember and never forget.

text: Tell me a story.
source_text: Tell me a story.

text: Okay, whatever.
source_text: Okay, whatever.

text: It is good not to forget.
source_text: It is good not to forget.

text: I'm sorry, child, I am tired right now. I need my rest. Please come back later.
source_text:
I'm sorry, child, I am tired right now. I need my rest. Please come
 back later.

text: How very true. [Agatha stares at you for a moment.] It is good for the young to remember, but it is very hard to act within the flow of history. Sometimes, the very course we take is determined by events long ago. May Dharma be with you. I must rest for a little while. Come back again, when I am stronger, and we will speak again.
source_text:
How very true. [Agatha stares at you for a moment.] It is good for
 the young to remember, but it is very hard to act within the flow of history.
 Sometimes, the very course we take is determined by events long ago. May Dharma
 be with you. I must rest for a little while. Come back again, when I am stronger,
 and we will speak again.

text: Thank you for asking. I'm just old, that's all. I cannot sleep at night. I close my eyes . . . [Agatha pauses.] But I get no rest. Please, it is just my old tired bones . . .
source_text:
Thank you for asking. I'm just old, that's all. I cannot sleep at night.
 I close my eyes . . . [Agatha pauses.] But I get no rest. Please, it is
 just my old tired bones . . .

text: I'm sorry, I'm very tired. Could you please come back later?
source_text: I'm sorry, I'm very tired. Could you please come back later?

text: Baba.
source_text: Baba.

text: Okay.
source_text: Okay.

text: Why are you so tired?
source_text: Why are you so tired?

text: I don't sleep well at night, my child. It must be my age.
source_text: I don't sleep well at night, my child. It must be my age.

text: Good day, my child. You look well. You remind me of my own baby.
source_text: Good day, my child. You look well. You remind me of my own baby.

text: Hng.
source_text: Hng.

text: I want a story, then.
source_text: I want a story, then.

text: I'm glad you are feeling better.
source_text: I'm glad you are feeling better.

text: Thank you. Goodbye.
source_text: Thank you. Goodbye.

text: You definitely remind me of my baby. When she was just a few months old, as a matter of fact.
source_text:
You definitely remind me of my baby. When she was just a few months
 old, as a matter of fact.

text: Thank you. Dharma always said that the farmer who plants politeness will walk easy when the season is over.
source_text:
Thank you. Dharma always said that the farmer who plants politeness will
 walk easy when the season is over.

text: Please tell me a story.
source_text: Please tell me a story.

text: This Dharma fellow sounds like an idiot.
source_text: This Dharma fellow sounds like an idiot.

text: You insult your elders. You should know better.
source_text: You insult your elders. You should know better.
